annotations.title: Find Booking Bench sites near a city

description: Lists live Booking Bench sites that have rental units in or near a destination city in the United States, nearest first, five per page. `city` is the destination the traveler names, never the traveler's own location. Each result has siteSlug, siteName, matchedCity, distanceMiles (straight-line, whole miles, between town centers), the cities the site has units in, and numberOfProperties. The answer states how many sites match in all (totalMatches) and gives nextCursor when more exist. Sites at the same distance are ordered by a daily rotation. A city name used in several states returns candidates; a misspelling returns suggestions.

city.description: The destination city name, for example "Deadwood".

cursor.description: The nextCursor from an earlier answer to the same search, unchanged.

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 10.

radiusMiles.description: Search radius in miles, 1 to 50. Default 15.

state.description: US state name or two-letter abbreviation, for example "SD".
